name: How do I choose the right fixtures and finishes for an ADU bathroom?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right fixtures and finishes for an ADU bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right fixtures and finishes for an ADU bathroom involves balancing durability, aesthetics, and budget. For a high-traffic rental ADU, opt for robust, easy-to-clean materials like porcelain tile and quartz countertops. If the ADU is for family use, you might prioritize comfort and personal style. Consider the overall aesthetic of the ADU and main home for cohesion. Water-efficient fixtures can also be a smart investment. Opus Builders can guide you through material selections that align with your vision and the ADU's purpose, ensuring quality and longevity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose ADU bathroom fixtures and finishes by balancing durability, aesthetics, budget, and the unit's intended use, prioritizing water efficiency and cohesive design.
